stem: Which sentence from the selection "The Ride of a Lifetime!" best supports the idea that Bud and Temple expected to have to take care of their own needs?
instruction: Use "The Ride of a Lifetime!" to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: They were not allowed to travel at all on Sundays. (paragraph 3)

options.label: G
options.text: The boys took off on their 2,000-mile trip departing from Frederick, Oklahoma. (paragraph 4)

options.label: H
options.text: They traveled with some extra clothes, oats for their horses, and food for themselves. (paragraph 4)

options.label: J
options.text: They crossed American Indian Territory, even stopping to rest at some Indian camps. (paragraph 5)
